items.question: Are you open to full-time opportunities?
items.answer: Yes. I am open to full-time opportunities. You can review my experience in the CV, connect with me on LinkedIn, or get in touch to discuss a role.

items.question: How does your pricing work?
items.answer: Every project is quoted based on scope, complexity, and timeline. After a short discovery call I'll send you a clear proposal with fixed pricing — no surprises.

items.question: What is your typical project timeline?
items.answer: Most projects take 2–6 weeks depending on scope. You'll receive a clear timeline in the proposal before we start.
